request: GPG to Vault cutover read-only prerequisites, never print secret values or sensitive file paths

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
v=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
l=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
body=VAULT_TUNNEL_CUTOVER_INVENTORY
for n in libral-vault-libral-vault-1 astera-v8-cloudflared; do
 if docker inspect "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  body="$body
$n=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.State.Status}}|{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')"
 else body="$body
$n=NOT_FOUND"; fi
done
for key in LIBRAL_VAULT_ASTERA_V8_TUNNEL_SECRET_ID LIBRAL_VAULT_ASTERA_V8_TUNNEL_RUNTIME_DIR; do
 if docker inspect libral-vault-libral-vault-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -q "^$key="; then val=PRESENT; else val=ABSENT; fi
 body="$body
$key=$val"
done
body="$body
VAULT_TUNNEL_API_IN_CHECKOUT=$(if grep -q 'astera-tunnel/materialize' "$l/src/server.ts"; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi)"
body="$body
LEGACY_FILE_REFERENCES=$(grep -Eil 'gpg-core|secure_up.sh|env.gpg' "$v/docker-compose.yml" "$v/scripts/prepare-vault-tunnel-secret.js" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
body="$body
V8_TOKEN_FILE_SETTING=$(if grep -q '^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE=' "$v/.env" 2>/dev/null; then echo PRESENT; else echo ABSENT; fi)"
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
